reason: Transitive report through eslint. Reviewed for 0.3.1: glob and minimatch are confined to trusted repository lint/type/cycle tooling and the unused js-beautify Node CLI. The application imports only js-beautify/js/src/index.js formatters; the packaged ZIP contains neither node_modules nor a Node runtime. No external glob patterns or AbortSignal filesystem traversal enter these paths. Fixes require a separate major tooling upgrade; minimatch 11 removes the callable/default export still used by ESLint and eslint-plugin-react.
